title: Add Multi-Step Form
content: Create multi-step form wizard. Container: max-w-2xl mx-auto. Progress: flex justify-between mb-8, step circles with numbers, connecting lines, completed steps green with checkmark. Step content: min-h-[300px] for consistent height. Form fields: standard inputs with validation. Navigation: flex justify-between mt-6, Back button (disabled on first step), Next/Submit button. Step transitions: fade or slide animation. Validation: validate current step before proceeding.

variants.simple: Create wizard-style multi-step form with progress indicator.
variants.detailed: Create multi-step form wizard. Container: max-w-2xl mx-auto. Progress: flex justify-between mb-8, step circles with numbers, connecting lines, completed steps green with checkmark. Step content: min-h-[300px] for consistent height. Form fields: standard inputs with validation. Navigation: flex justify-between mt-6, Back button (disabled on first step), Next/Submit button. Step transitions: fade or slide animation. Validation: validate current step before proceeding.
variants.advanced: Create advanced multi-step form with validation and persistence. Progress indicator: numbered circles connected by lines, states (completed/current/upcoming), step labels below circles, clickable to navigate (if previous steps valid). Step management: useState for currentStep, steps array with {id, title, component, validation}. Form state: useForm (react-hook-form) or useReducer for complex state. Validation: per-step validation schema (Zod/Yup), validate on Next click, show errors inline. Conditional steps: skip certain steps based on previous answers. Step content: each step is separate component receiving form context. Navigation: Back always enabled (except step 1), Next validates then advances, on last step shows Submit. Save progress: localStorage persistence, resume from where left off. Review step: final step shows summary of all inputs, edit buttons to jump to specific steps. Submit handling: loading state, success/error feedback. Accessibility: focus management on step change, announce step changes to screen readers. Mobile: progress shows current/total instead of all circles, swipe gestures optional. Animation: AnimatePresence with direction-aware slide (slide left going forward, right going back).
